documents.title: Canada's new lunar utility rover will help astronauts build a future on the Moon (CSA news release)
published_requirements_quoted: Survive the roughly two-week-long lunar night, with temperatures as low as -200 °C
Support a lifespan of minimum 10 years

documents.title: CSA Lunar Exploration Accelerator Program (LEAP) - lunar rover Phase A studies (MDA, Canadensys)
documents.note: Phase A studies addressed lunar-night survival, power generation and storage; no numerical power figures are published.

how_used_in_models.ThermalConfig.env_temp_dark_c: -200 °C dark sink temperature for survival-heater demand (CSA LUV requirement).
how_used_in_models.scenario extended_dark: 14-day zero-generation event = CSA 'roughly two-week-long lunar night'.
how_used_in_models.lifetime: 10-year minimum design life motivates the configurable degradation_factor (aging) in Model 4; no CSA degradation rate is published, so the value is an assumption.

not_available_from_csa: subsystem power ratings and duty cycles
policy: No CSA specification is invented. Every parameter in the list above is an explicitly labelled, user-configurable engineering assumption in clps_engine/power_gen.py and clps_engine/energy.py.
